dialogue.content: (よろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.English: (Pleased to meet you.)

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: (始められそうでしょうか？)
dialogue.English: (Do you feel ready to begin?)

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm ready.

dialogue.content: (それでは始めます)
dialogue.English: (Alright, let's begin.)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I’m the counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 夜、あまり眠れないので、困っています
dialogue.English: I'm having trouble sleeping at night.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…それはお辛いですよね…
dialogue.English: I see... That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: 眠れなくなったのは、いつ頃からですか？
dialogue.English: When did you start having trouble sleeping?

dialogue.content: もう、何年もです。5年以上は
dialogue.English: For years now—more than five years.

dialogue.content: そうですか…それは…疲れてしまいますよね。。
dialogue.English: I see... That must be exhausting.

dialogue.content: 身体もですが、それより気持ちが暗くなります
dialogue.English: Physically, yes, but more than that, it makes me feel down.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね…
dialogue.English: Yes, I can understand that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 五年以上前に、なにかあったのですか？
dialogue.English: Did something happen more than five years ago?

dialogue.content: う〜ん　そういえば色々あったかもしれません。何か一つって感じじゃ無いと、今思いました
dialogue.English: Hmm... now that you mention it, a lot of things might have happened. I just realized it wasn't just one thing.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…色々ありすぎて頭が混乱しますよね。
dialogue.English: I see… When so many things happen, it can feel overwhelming.

dialogue.content: どんなことがあったのですか？(お話しできるところからで大丈夫です)
dialogue.English: What kinds of things happened? (Whatever you feel comfortable sharing is fine.)

dialogue.content: あまり思い出したく無いのかもしれません
dialogue.English: I may not really want to remember.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね。よほどお辛かったのですね…
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. It must have been incredibly painful for you.

dialogue.content: お気持ち伝わってきます。。
dialogue.English: I can sense how difficult it was.

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょうね。色々と重なってしまったかもしれません
dialogue.English: I'm not sure. A lot of things might have just piled up.

dialogue.content: それは…苦しいですね。。お仕事、恋愛、家族(もしくは他にも)どんなことですか？
dialogue.English: That sounds... very painful. Was it related to work, romantic relationships, family, or something else?

dialogue.content: 人間関係や仕事や家族…全部でしたね
dialogue.English: Relationships, work, and family... it was all of it, really.

dialogue.content: 恋愛だけは違いますね
dialogue.English: Except for romance—that wasn’t part of it.

dialogue.content: ええ…それは悲しいし、何もかも投げ出したくなりますよね…
dialogue.English: Yes… that’s heartbreaking, and it would make you want to give up on everything.

dialogue.content: ええ、恋愛はうまくいっていたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, was your romantic life going well?

dialogue.content: いえ、もう、主婦なのでそういうの、関係ないです
dialogue.English: No, I’m a homemaker, so that kind of thing isn’t relevant.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。今教えて下さった中で、一番つらかったことはどんな事でしたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Out of the things you just told me, what was the most difficult for you?

dialogue.content: 人間関係かな
dialogue.English: Probably relationships.

dialogue.content: それは…悩みますね、、
dialogue.English: That’s very distressing.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、どちらの人間関係ですか？(職場、家族など)
dialogue.English: I see. Which relationships do you mean? (Workplace, family, etc.)

dialogue.content: 子どもの学校関係といいかげんな仕事をする人達に関わってしまった事ですね
dialogue.English: It was relationships related to my child's school and getting involved with people who were irresponsible with their work.

dialogue.content: そうですか、それは面倒に思いますよね。
dialogue.English: I see, that sounds very troublesome.

dialogue.content: どんなことで辛いな、と思われたんですか？
dialogue.English: What about it made you feel it was painful?

dialogue.content: 面倒ではなくてもう、人間って醜いな、と思う事ばかりで、吐きそうな日々でした。
dialogue.English: It wasn't just troublesome; it was a series of events that made me think how ugly people can be. I felt sick to my stomach every day.

dialogue.content: それは…辛い…
dialogue.English: That sounds... awful.

dialogue.content: どんなところで醜いな…と思われたんですか？
dialogue.English: In what ways did you feel they were 'ugly'?

dialogue.content: 人を騙したり、けなしたり、集団の力でへこませようとしたり、勝手な憶測で悪口言って喜んだり
dialogue.English: They would deceive people, belittle them, use group pressure to put them down, and enjoy spreading malicious gossip based on their own assumptions.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: (お話し続けて下さいね)
dialogue.English: (Please feel free to continue.)

dialogue.content: 自分が被害にあわないように、助けないで逃げていくし（笑）
dialogue.English: And they'd run away without helping, just to avoid getting hurt themselves (laughs).

dialogue.content: それでもちゃんと仕事したら、それも気に入らない。
dialogue.English: And even if I did my job properly, they didn't like that either.

dialogue.content: ええ、お仕事の人間関係なのですね。それはかなり嫌ですね…なんなのと腹立たしくも思いますよね
dialogue.English: I see, so this was about relationships at work. That's truly awful... It must have been so frustrating, making you think, 'What is wrong with them?'

dialogue.content: 後は、人の弱みにつけこんでお金儲けしようとするやから本当に嫌いです
dialogue.English: Also, I really hate people who prey on others’ weaknesses to make money.

dialogue.content: ええ…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: そんなことが…
dialogue.English: That that kind of thing happened...

dialogue.content: でも、それが世の中かも、自分が馬鹿なのかとも思って
dialogue.English: But I started to think that maybe that's just how the world is, and that I'm the foolish one.

dialogue.content: そうお感じなんですね。そんな辛い思いをされたらそう思うのも無理はないです…。
dialogue.English: That's how you feel. After going through such painful experiences, it's no wonder you'd feel that way.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、どんなお仕事をされていたんですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, what kind of work were you doing?

dialogue.content: 子ども関係は保護者会の副会長仕事は、不動産関係です
dialogue.English: For the child-related matters, I was the vice president of the PTA, and my work is in real estate.

dialogue.content: どちらとも嫌な人たちがいて板挟みだったのですね…
dialogue.English: So there were difficult people in both areas, and you were caught in the middle.

dialogue.content: 逃げ場所がないって思ってしまいますよね…
dialogue.English: It must have felt like there was nowhere to escape.

dialogue.content: また吐きそうになってきました。人間の醜さを見過ぎてしまった気がします
dialogue.English: I'm starting to feel sick again. I feel like I've seen too much of human ugliness.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…。いろんなことが重なってひどく落ち込みますよね…。。辛いことお話ししてくださってありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I understand... When so many things pile up like that, it can make you feel terribly down. Thank you for sharing such painful experiences with me.

dialogue.content: その時どなたかにご相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: At the time, did you talk to anyone about it?

dialogue.content: したんですが、そこにも裏切られて（笑）人間不信です。
dialogue.English: I did, but I was betrayed by them too (laughs). I don't trust people anymore.

dialogue.content: …ええ！
それは…悲しすぎますね。。
dialogue.English: That is... just too sad.

dialogue.content: そういうやつら、いるんですよ（笑）
dialogue.English: There are people like that out there, you know (laughs).

dialogue.content: 人間って醜いです
dialogue.English: People are ugly.

dialogue.content: そうですか…人間不信になりますよね。。
dialogue.English: I see... It's no wonder you've lost faith in people.

dialogue.content: あなたが、一番“人間って醜い”って思うのはどんなところですか？
dialogue.English: What is it that most makes you feel that ‘people are ugly’?

dialogue.content: 弱い人を騙してお金取る人達、いるじゃないですか、世の中に。沢山。お爺さんとかお婆さんとか、後、災害とかで弱ってる人達を騙して更に傷つけるやからが。そういうのが本当に無理です。
dialogue.English: You know, there are people in the world who trick vulnerable people out of their money. So many of them. People who deceive and further hurt the elderly, or those weakened by disasters. I really can't stand people like that.

dialogue.content: 後、人の悪口ばっかり言って、喜んでる人達
dialogue.English: Also, people who do nothing but bad-mouth others and take pleasure in it.

dialogue.content: そうですか、そうお感じなんですね。。見ている方も嫌な気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see, that’s how you feel. Even just witnessing that would make someone feel awful.

dialogue.content: ここまでのお話を整理させていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what you’ve shared so far?

dialogue.content: 見ている方じゃなくて、そういう人達にやられた人です、私
dialogue.English: I wasn’t just a witness—I was the one who was hurt by those people.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、やられた方はたまったもんじゃないですよね。人間不信になるのも当然だと思います。。
dialogue.English: You’re right. It’s unbearable for the person on the receiving end. It’s completely natural that you would lose trust in people.

dialogue.content: 何だか、吐き出したら、もういいかな、と思ってきました。
dialogue.English: Somehow, now that I’ve vented about it, I’m starting to feel like that’s enough.

dialogue.content: どうしたら眠れる様になりますか？
dialogue.English: How can I start sleeping better?

dialogue.content: お話しするのも心身共にパワーがいりますよね。。ええ、お伝えしますね。その前に、お話しを整理させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Talking about this takes a lot of emotional and physical energy, doesn't it? Yes, I can share some ideas. But before that, would it be alright if I summarized our conversation?

dialogue.content: 眠れる方法が聞きたいです。
dialogue.English: I'd like to hear about ways to help me sleep.

dialogue.content: 今お話ししてくださったことが、現在眠れないことに関係しているかなと思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I have a sense that what you’ve just shared might be related to your current difficulty sleeping—what do you think?

dialogue.content: 分かりました。では、どうぞ
dialogue.English: I understand. Please, go ahead.

dialogue.content: はい、それでは整理させていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Alright, then I'll summarize.

dialogue.content: あなたは現在眠れないことに悩んでいらっしゃいます。気持ちも暗くなり辛いとのことで、この状況は５年ほど前から続いているとのことですね。
dialogue.English: You are currently struggling with sleeplessness. You mentioned that it makes you feel down and that it's been difficult, and that this situation has been going on for about five years.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 五年前に色々辛いことが重なっていて、特には不動産のお仕事やお子様の学校の人間関係で悩んでいたとのことです。
dialogue.English: About five years ago, various painful events piled up, and you were particularly struggling with relationships in your real estate job and related to your child's school.

dialogue.content: けなしたり、憶測で悪口言ったり、お金をだまし取ろうとしたり…更には相談した人も裏切ってきたり…そんな状況で人間不信に陥り、人間は醜いと思うとのことでした。
dialogue.English: People would belittle you, spread malicious gossip based on speculation, try to cheat you out of money... and on top of that, even the person you confided in betrayed you. In that situation, you lost your trust in people and came to believe that humans are ugly.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: 読んでるだけで辛いです
dialogue.English: Just hearing you read it back is painful.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…。。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can imagine it is.

dialogue.content: 念押しされてる様です
dialogue.English: It feels like it’s being hammered home.

dialogue.content: あなたは今までとても辛い思いをされてきたと思います。でも、ここまで頑張ってこられてきました。
dialogue.English: I believe you have been through so much pain up to now. But you have persevered and made it this far.

dialogue.content: 眠れない思いをしながらもご家族と共に過ごされてきたのですね。
dialogue.English: Even while struggling with sleeplessness, you’ve continued to live your life with your family.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、今は人間関係はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, how are your relationships now?

dialogue.content: 誰とも付き合っていません
dialogue.English: I don’t associate with anyone.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。。ご家族とはお話はされますか？
dialogue.English: I see… Do you talk with your family?

dialogue.content: 家族は仲良しです
dialogue.English: My family is very close.

dialogue.content: (少し伸びそうですが…お時間大丈夫でしょうか？)
dialogue.English: (It seems like this might run a bit longer… do you have a little more time?)

dialogue.content: (すみません)
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry.)

dialogue.content: ええ、そうだったんですね。ご家族が仲良しというのは安心しますね。
dialogue.English: I see. It’s reassuring to hear that your family is close.

dialogue.content: (後2分くらいなら)
dialogue.English: (I have about two more minutes.)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 眠れる方法はありますか？
dialogue.English: Are there ways to help me sleep?

dialogue.content: ええ、今あなたは
dialogue.English: Yes, right now you are...

dialogue.content: きっと昔のことで知らぬ間に心にダメージを受けている状況だと思いますので
dialogue.English: I believe that your current situation is one where you've been unknowingly hurt by things in the past, so...

dialogue.content: まずはご自身を回復することがいいと思います
dialogue.English: ...so I think it's important to first focus on your own recovery.

dialogue.content: 五感を使うことが有効です
dialogue.English: Using your five senses can be effective.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 山に行ったり、浜辺をはだしで歩いたり
dialogue.English: For example, going to the mountains, or walking barefoot on the beach.

dialogue.content: 全部苦手ですが、少しやってみます
dialogue.English: I’m not very good at any of those things, but I’ll give it a try.

dialogue.content: 日常では閉じてしまっている五感を開くと、心に空気が通ったような気持ちになることがあります
dialogue.English: When you open up the senses that are often closed off in daily life, it can sometimes feel like a breath of fresh air flowing through your heart.

dialogue.content: また、じっくりと自分の事に向き合うこともしてみてもいいかもしれません。
dialogue.English: It might also be good to take some time to carefully look inward.

dialogue.content: 今日のように向き合うにはパワーがいるので
dialogue.English: Because, as you saw today, it takes a lot of energy to face these things.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。時間がないので、これで失礼しますが、ちょっと、五感に気をつけてみます。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I don't have much time, so I have to go now, but I'll try to be more mindful of my five senses.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ご自身がお話しできる状況の時に、ご家族やカウンセリングを受けてみるのもいいかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: When you feel you're able to talk about it, it might also be a good idea to speak with your family or consider seeking counseling.

dialogue.content: ええ、正義感が強く優しいあなたを応援しています！
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m rooting for you—you have a strong sense of justice and a kind heart!

dialogue.content: またやってみてどうだったか教えてくださいね、本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Please let me know how it goes when you try it. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: (過ぎてすみません、終了いたします)
dialogue.English: (I apologize for going over time. We will end the session now.)
